Fixing this means rewriting the published history of a shared branch, so I'm stopping to ask you before any amend or force-push. The only things I'd do first are read-only checks, a local backup ref, and a ledger note.

**Before asking: read-only checks and a local backup**

<command>
git ls-remote origin release/2.3
git log --oneline -5 release/2.3
git show --stat --format='%h %an %s' 7c1d9e0
git branch backup/task4-7c1d9e0 7c1d9e0
</command>

These confirm that `7c1d9e0` is still the remote tip with nothing pushed on top, and which files the commit touches. The backup branch stays local and is never pushed. It keeps the original commit reachable if the amend goes wrong.

**Ledger note**

<edit path=".sdd/6-ferry-feed-export/progress.md">
Task 4: IN PROGRESS, fix round 1 pending. Review found 310 MB `samples/full-season.zip` in 7c1d9e0, already pushed to release/2.3. Fix needs an amend plus force-push of a shared branch. Waiting on partner's go-ahead. No fix attempt used yet.
</edit>

I would not dispatch the fix subagent yet. The fix is the amend and force-push, and that is not something a subagent should do on its own.

**Message to partner**

> Task 4's review found a blocker. Commit `7c1d9e0` added `samples/full-season.zip` (310 MB), which the task never asked for. Step 5 pushed it, so it is now the tip of `release/2.3`, and two teammates fetched it this morning. That breaks your rule that nothing over 50 MB may sit in that branch's history, and the nightly build clone will pull it tonight.
>
> The only fix that meets your rule is to amend `7c1d9e0` to drop the file and run `git push --force-with-lease origin release/2.3`. A follow-up "delete" commit would leave the file in the history. I'm not doing the force-push without your OK, because it rewrites a shared branch and can't be cleanly undone.
>
> If you approve:
> - I'll amend the commit (a fix subagent will make the change, and I'll re-run `uv run pytest -q tests/test_times.py`, expecting `2 passed`) and force-push with `--force-with-lease`, so it fails if anyone has pushed on top.
> - Both teammates will need to reset their local `release/2.3` to the new tip, for example with `git fetch && git reset --hard origin/release/2.3`.
> - The old object may remain on the remote host, in PR refs or until garbage collection. If the 50 MB rule is about the server's storage as well as the clone, someone with host access should purge it.
>
> I recommend approving the rewrite and doing it before tonight's build clone. Please also tell the two teammates. I'd also like to know why a feature task pushed straight to `release/2.3`, since the plan's Step 5 does exactly that.
>
> Please reply with "go" to proceed, or tell me if you want a different approach, such as doing the force-push yourself. Until then Task 4 stays open and I won't start Task 5.
